info.title: Qwen text-to-image
info.description: Ali Qwen text-to-image capability documentation. The unified API endpoint is `/v1/images/generations`. This document describes the public gateway contract for `qwen-image-2.0-pro` and `qwen-image-3.0-pro`: `input.messages[].content[].text` carries the prompt, while other control fields use top-level OpenAI-style fields that the gateway maps to upstream `parameters`.

post.description:
Calls Ali `qwen-image-2.0-pro` or `qwen-image-3.0-pro` to perform text-to-image generation.

The public calling convention keeps top-level `model`, `input`, `response_format`, and exposes `n`, `size`, `negative_prompt`, `prompt_extend`, `watermark`, `seed` as top-level fields. The prompt is placed in `input.messages[0].content[0].text`. The request body does not accept a top-level `parameters` field.

content.text: A cute orange cat sitting on a windowsill, bathed in sunlight, realistic style
Sci-fi cityscape at night, neon lights, futuristic architecture

200.description: Success. Returns the image generation result.

401.description: Authentication failed, e.g. missing or invalid token.

429.description: Rate limit triggered or insufficient account quota.

500.description: Internal server error while processing the request.

502.description: Upstream provider returned an abnormal response.

503.description: Upstream provider is temporarily unavailable, or no available channel for the current model.

BearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.

response_format.description: Response format. `url` returns an image download link; `b64_json` returns Base64-encoded image data. Default is `url`.

n.description: Number of output images. Default is 1. For the `qwen-image-2.0` and `qwen-image-3.0` series, you can generate 1-6 images.

size.description: Output image resolution in `width*height` format. For the `qwen-image-2.0` and `qwen-image-3.0` series, total output pixels must be between `512*512` and `2048*2048`, and the default resolution is `1024*1024`. Recommended resolutions: `2688*1536` (16:9), `1536*2688` (9:16), `1024*1024` (1:1, default), `2368*1728` (4:3), and `1728*2368` (3:4).

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt used to describe content that should not appear in the image and to constrain the image. Chinese and English are supported. Maximum length is 500 characters; extra content is automatically truncated. Example: low resolution, low quality, malformed limbs, malformed fingers, oversaturated image, wax figure appearance, no facial details, overly smooth, AI-like image, chaotic composition, blurry or distorted text.

prompt_extend.description: Whether to enable smart prompt rewriting. When enabled, the model optimizes and polishes the positive prompt. This feature does not modify the negative prompt. `true` (default): enabled, recommended for more diverse content. `false`: disabled, recommended for more controllable details.

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark in the lower-right corner of the image. Default is `false`. For `qwen-image-2.0-pro`, the watermark is "Qwen-Image"; for `qwen-image-3.0-pro`, the watermark is "AI生成".

seed.description: Random seed. Range [0, 2147483647]. Using the same `seed` value can make generated content relatively stable. If omitted, the algorithm automatically uses a random seed. Note: generation is probabilistic, so the same `seed` cannot guarantee identical results every time.

messages.description: Request content array. Currently only single-turn conversations are supported, and the array must contain exactly one element.

role.description: Message role. This parameter must be set to `user`.

content.description: Message content array. Only one `text` item is supported; omitting it or passing multiple text items causes an error.

text.description: Positive prompt used to describe the image content, style, and composition you want to generate. Chinese and English are supported. The `qwen-image-2.0` and `qwen-image-3.0` series support up to 1300 tokens; other models support up to 800 tokens. Extra content is automatically truncated.

size.description: Output image resolution in `width*height` format. For the `qwen-image-2.0` and `qwen-image-3.0` series, total output pixels must be between `512*512` and `2048*2048`, and the default resolution is `2048*2048`. Recommended resolutions: `2688*1536` (16:9), `1536*2688` (9:16), `2048*2048` (1:1, default), `2368*1728` (4:3), and `1728*2368` (3:4).

n.description: Number of output images. Default is 1. For the `qwen-image-2.0` and `qwen-image-3.0` series, you can generate 1-6 images.

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt used to describe content that should not appear in the image and to constrain the image. Chinese and English are supported. Maximum length is 500 characters; extra content is automatically truncated. Example: low resolution, low quality, malformed limbs, malformed fingers, oversaturated image, wax figure appearance, no facial details, overly smooth, AI-like image, chaotic composition, blurry or distorted text.

prompt_extend.description: Whether to enable smart prompt rewriting. When enabled, the model optimizes and polishes the positive prompt. This feature does not modify the negative prompt. `true` (default): enabled, recommended for more diverse content. `false`: disabled, recommended for more controllable details.

watermark.description: Whether to add a "Qwen-Image" watermark in the lower-right corner of the image. Default is `false`.

seed.description: Random seed. Range [0, 2147483647]. Using the same `seed` value can make generated content relatively stable. If omitted, the algorithm automatically uses a random seed. Note: generation is probabilistic, so the same `seed` cannot guarantee identical results every time.

metadata.description: Pass-through raw response metadata from the upstream provider.

url.description: Used when the result is returned as a URL.

b64_json.description: Used when the result is returned as Base64.

revised_prompt.description: Revised prompt returned by the upstream provider.
